translation: Say, Brigade Chief.

Huh, it's pretty rare for you to refer to me
that way.

It's only because the mood is right, and it's
fitting for what I want to talk about.

Well, it's just… There's something I want to
ask you, as the brigade chief.

Can't we do this later? We're in the middle of
something here.
Come on, don't say that.

What I want to ask about is whether anyone
will ever inherit the position of brigade chief.

There's obviously no way that's ever going to
happen.

There's only one SOS Brigade Chief! It's simply
impossible for it to be anyone but me.
That may be true, but…

We submitted this club to the school as a
student association or whatever.
Well, not that we were accepted, anyway.

And so next year, we might have some new
students join, you know?

Not that I believe in the possibility even one
bit.

What's more—eventually we'll have to
graduate and leave it all behind.

When that time comes, what do you plan to do
about the members who get left behind?

Right… Well by that point, the SOS Brigade will
have expanded into a worldwide organization.
Huh…?

They could always inherit this place as the
original birthplace of the SOS Brigade.
But when the time comes…

…we definitely might need to choose a
successor.

Of course, it would only be proper for the
interviews to be conducted by yours truly.

We can't afford to accept anyone short of
the perfect candidate, you know?

But then again, I'm not sure if someone who
can live up to my standards even exists.
Ah, is that so?

I wonder if she'll still be dragging me around,
working me to death even then.
I really don't want to dwell on that thought…
S-Suzumiya!
Hm? What is it, Mikuru?
Umm, the, umm…
Why did you suddenly call out to me?
U-uhh…

Just spit it out! If there's something you
want to say, then cut to the chase already!
I-it's just…

Wh-what are the qualifications to become
brigade chief?!
…Huh?

Wh-what? Is that maybe a weird thing to
ask?!

Hmmm… So you're looking to become brigade
chief?

That's a surprisingly bold thing for you to
say, Mikuru.
Ehh, no, i-it's not like that—
It's fine, I'll tell you.
You will…?

In order to become the SOS Brigade's
illustrious chief, you must…
You must…?
First, you must defeat me!
Eek?! Defeat you?!
Of course!

In ancient Rome, becoming the new emperor
meant overthrowing the previous one!
Ehhhh?!
The SOS Brigade works the same way!

Only those whose strength I've tested myself
are worthy of becoming our next brigade chief.

With that said—I'll accept your challenge
anytime, Mikuru.
I-I don't particularly wan—

Oh yeah! Call Koizumi and Yuki over and we'll
have a tournament!
Nah, I'm just messing with you.

The status of SOS Brigade Chief—it's a
unique and irreplaceable way of life.
Of course. I understand what you mean.
What is an SOS Brigade Chief?
That's a strange thing for you to ask, Yuki.
The nature of its being is of great interest.
Hmm, right. Well, if I were to sum it up…
It's me, Haruhi Suzumiya!

The objective of the SOS Brigade is to liven
things up in the world.

Why you ask? Because I want to have fun, of
course.

Our goal is to gather all the mysteries of the
world and bring them to me one after another!

Personally, I think that would make things
way, way more exciting for everyone.
You get me?
I understand the objective.

Alright, great. So do your best as a brigade
member, okay Yuki?
Understood.
I've wanted to ask something for a while.
What is it, Koizumi?

Your prospects—or rather—your long-term
plan for the position of SOS Brigade Chief.

Hmm, I see. Certainly you would be curious, as
a brigade member yourself.

Yes. Ideally, I'd like to continue my activity
within the SOS Brigade for as long as possible.
That's a great attitude to have.

If I had to sum it up in just one word…
Maybe globalization.
Globalization… is it?

Yep. Right now, we're still only occupying North
High along with the surrounding area.

I'd like to expand our territory bit by bit. We'll
first spread through all of mainland Japan.

From that point, I plan to continue spreading
our activities all around the world.

Worldwide expansion… As expected of Miss
Suzumiya—the greatest visionary of us all!

At the end of the day, simply staying active
doesn't mean much.

The crucial part is that we're able to verify
the hidden mysteries of the world.

I—the SOS Brigade Chief—will confirm these
secrets with my own eyes.

If we can do that much, the world will be way
more fun and interesting—I'm sure of it!

I didn't realize you had such magnificent
plans.
With that being said, Koizumi…

I hope you'll continue your outstanding
service from here on out!
Indeed. I'm always prepared to give my all.

Good answer! That's exactly why you were
chosen as an SOS Brigade member, after all.
